name: Lucius
summary: At the Lakeshire docks, Lucius watches the Redridge waterfront. The dwarf works undercover for Stormwind’s SI:7, helping agents with reconnaissance and trade skills.

sections.title: Eyes in the Mountains
sections.body: Lucius watches the Lakeshire docks for SI:7, Stormwind’s intelligence service. He keeps an eye on trade, unusual traffic, and threats moving into the Redridge Mountains. Agents sent east from Stormwind come to him to coordinate covert work and practice field skills such as lockpicking. Through Lucius, Stormwind keeps a hidden reach beyond Elwynn Forest.

aliases: who is the dwarf on the docks
faq.answer: Lucius is a dwarf agent in Lakeshire who works for SI:7, Stormwind’s intelligence service.

faq.q: What does Lucius do in Lakeshire?
aliases: why is lucius on the docks
faq.answer: Lucius helps covert agents with local instruction in thievery and lockpicking, while watching movements across the Redridge Mountains.
Lucius handles the SI:7 mission ‘Redridge Rendezvous’ and sends young rogues to pick the locks of chests at Alther’s Mill for their Certificate of Thievery.

angles.text: As a rogue sent east from Stormwind, you can turn to Lucius for instruction in lockpicking and reconnaissance.
As a dwarf, Lucius shows how your people’s talents can serve Stormwind’s covert operations as well as the forge and front line.
